name: subscriby-zapier
description: Zapier Platform integration for Subscriby — monetised Telegram community automation.

scripts.prebuild: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');const s=require('fs').readFileSync('src/utils/http.ts','utf8');if(!s.includes('INTEGRATION_VERSION = \"'+p.version+'\"')){console.error('src/utils/http.ts INTEGRATION_VERSION does not match package.json '+p.version+' — the User-Agent would report the wrong version.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.push:win: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Move-Item -Path .git -Destination ../.git-mp-zap; npm run build; zapier push; Move-Item -Path ../.git-mp-zap -Destination .git"
